idea-plugin.name: FatJar Builder
idea-plugin.description:
FatJar Builder

Build a single deployable fat JAR from any IntelliJ module with one click. The Eclipse FatJar plugin equivalent for IntelliJ IDEA.

Features

  • Build menu → FatJar Builder → Build Fat JAR
  • Add as a Before launch task in any run configuration
  • Artifact system integration (File → Project Structure → Artifacts)
  • Browses compiled classes to find and select your main class
  • Recursively includes all dependent module compiled classes
  • Supports both Maven and Gradle projects
  • Extracts all dependency JARs into a single flat JAR
  • Merges META-INF/services files correctly (SLF4J, JAXB etc.)
  • Strips JAR signatures automatically (no more SecurityException)
  • Excludes unwanted packages with Ant-style glob patterns
  • Shows detailed timestamped build output in a dedicated tool window
  • Notification with open folder link after successful build
  • Remembers settings per module between sessions

Why?

Teams migrating from Eclipse miss the FatJar plugin. Maven shade plugin works but breaks the IntelliJ debugger when delegation is enabled. This plugin builds a deployable fat JAR without touching your Maven/Gradle build configuration.

action.description: Build a deployable fat JAR for this module
